pill.desc: yellowish-white lyophilized powder in a single-dose vial

clues.kinetics: Given only by intravenous infusion, and the antibody is broken down to peptides and amino acids. The payload is about 97% protein bound and primarily metabolized by CYP3A4.
clues.substance: A humanized biologic made in Chinese hamster ovary cells by recombinant DNA technology, supplied as a preservative-free lyophilized powder in 100 mg single-dose vials.
clues.product: Approved under a BLA in a single 100 mg vial strength, given at 5.4 mg/kg every 3 weeks.
clues.safety: Boxed warning for interstitial lung disease, pneumonitis and embryo-fetal toxicity. Nausea and decreased white blood cell count are the most common adverse reactions.
clues.indication: Biomarker-selected breast cancer: early disease as neoadjuvant or adjuvant treatment, and metastatic disease first-line as part of a combination.
clues.mechanism: Binds HER2 on tumor cells, is internalized, and releases a topoisomerase I inhibitor that damages DNA and causes cell death.

tell: Its 5.4 to 5.7 day half-life and topoisomerase I payload set this HER2-directed antibody-drug conjugate apart.
